name: kiwi-code
description: Integrates Codex CLI with Kiwi Code activity, thread naming, process shells, retained implementation plans, and the thread-owned in-app browser.

interface.longDescription: Kiwi Code gives managed Codex CLI sessions lifecycle and thread-title hooks, persistent process helpers, retained plans, and browser tools that control the same in-app browser shown in the thread workspace.
